header.description: Coaxial translation coefficients (E|F)^m_{n'n} of the real orthonormal basis (CONVENTIONS §3.15, Coaxial translations; Helmholtz CH1.2c; spike S2's sets)
header.format: per set: op RR ((R|R) = (S|S)) or SR ((S|R)); z = k t and g = s as decimal strings of doubles; kind, ka, eps, translation (m2m, m2l), k = [re, im] for a = 1, t, a, d2 (m2l); p_src, p_tgt; sampled entries (m, row n', col n) with value [re, im] in the stored normalisation of §3.15; the start values f^_l at radial_l in radial; pairs as shortest round-trip decimal strings
